name: High Inquisitor Mordred Hirculi
desc:
High Inquisitor Mordred Hirculi is a Vesperian NPC. He was the lead of the Inquisitor division for [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority) garrison positioned in the Eastern Luminant, the first to possess this rank.

Mordred also possessed unknown ties to the [Circle of Honour](faction:circle_of_honour), and was aware of [Warden Jericho](entity:warden_jericho)'s allegiance to the information.

Mordred was an elderly man and eventually died in his sleep. He was succeeded by [High Inquisitor Merey](entity:high_inquisitor_merey), who had been assigned as his successor prior to his passing, as the two had a good relationship during his career.

He appears aged with grey hair. He wears an Inquisitor's Visor, a Fleet Warden Cape, an Inquisitor's Duster, and a pair of Grand Authority Sabatons.
additional_info: -   Mordred is a figure in Arthurian legend. Details vary greatly, but Mordred is generally characterized in popular culture as a villainous relative of King Arthur's who serves as a member of his Knights of the Round Table, before he eventually betrays and kills Arthur for the throne.
